sections.label: Abandoned nursing home residents assistance
sections.summary: Asks about abandoned residents, unpaid bills, nursing home procedures, and Government assistance including subsidies, MediFund and legal recourse.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Health (a) for each year from 2011 till 2016, how many residents in nursing homes were abandoned by their next-of-kin and how many were unable to pay their bills; (b) what is the typical procedure that nursing home operators follow in such cases; and (c) how are the operators of nursing homes assisted by the Government in dealing with the cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: When families fail to visit, nursing home staff will try to re-establish contact.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Government provides means-tested subsidies of up to 75% of nursing home costs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Residents who require additional assistance can tap on financial assistance schemes, such as MediFund.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Nursing homes can also provide assistance to eligible residents to seek legal recourse under the Maintenance of Parents Act if they wish to do so.

sections.label: Financial assistance for nursing home costs
sections.summary: States Government provides means-tested financial assistance and MediFund for residents unable to pay nursing home costs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: With regard to residents who are unable to pay for the nursing home cost, the Government does provide financial assistance for those who are eligible under the means testing regime.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: For those who cannot pay the remaining portions of their bills, they can also tap on MediFund as well.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The Government cannot mandate filial piety but will definitely step in to help whenever possible.
